To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
homework is a common and pervasive educational practice and that students often experience difficulty in completing their homework.
students who are successful in completing their homework do not have to be superhuman.
Students who have difficulty doing homework often lack the self-regulation skills necessary for managing their own learning and that these skills can be taught and learned.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the question of how students can be helped to do their homework more responsibly, that is, with a greater degree of effort, focus, persistence, and motivation, and with less procrastination and avoidance.
the question, “What are the challenges of completing homework and what are the most effective ways to deal with these problems?”

understanding the nature and extent of the challenges that students experience in doing homework, the strategies that they employ to overcome these challenges, and the factors that contribute to the effectiveness of the strategies that they use.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

students face many homework challenges, including those that relate to arranging a conducive homework setting, managing their time, handling homework distractions and keeping themselves motivated, and dealing with negative affect.
students are not able to complete homework because of the lack of time and motivation.
homework has a positive impact on the academic performance of the students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
homework management is a complex process, and that it requires students, teachers, and families to work together in a collaborative fashion if homework is to be completed successfully.
homework management is a complex task, and that students need a range of skills, strategies, and resources to complete their assignments.
homework can be a powerful learning tool, but only if students can manage the process of completing their homework in a productive manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
students’ homework management strategies are not only important for students’ homework performance, but also for their homework motivation and homework attitudes.
students who have difficulty managing their homework often lack the skills to do so, rather than the motivation.
students need to be taught how to manage their homework.
